Details
  • Paper: FoundationStereo: Zero-Shot Stereo Matching, CVPR 2025, 2025-01-17
  • Original code: https://github.com/NVlabs/FoundationStereo at 6e8806816b53
  • Code licence: LicenseRef-NVIDIA-Source-Code-License-NC AND Apache-2.0 (noncommercial); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: LicenseRef-NVIDIA-Source-Code-License-NC
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/NVlabs/FoundationStereo/blob/6e8806816b533e4d13ddbb95ffa907b797060a62/readme.md#L158
  • Training data: Foundation Stereo Dataset (FSD, synthetic, NVIDIA) plus SceneFlow, Falling Things, Sintel, CREStereo, InStereo2K and others; no per-dataset terms checked
  • Licence note: Code and weights are under the NVIDIA Source Code License-NC (non-commercial research use only). Our kernels for this family count as derived work and inherit the NC limit; the family ships in fastforks-nc.
  • Options: iters = 32 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: fs, fs_cutlass, cudnn_hacc, fastbb
  • Variants: foundationstereo-vit-l, foundationstereo-vit-s
  • Outputs: disparity
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): foundationstereo-vit-l 1988x2880 (7.1 GiB peak allocated, 11.4 reserved); foundationstereo-vit-s 1988x2880 (6.5 GiB peak allocated, 10.7 reserved)
  • foundationstereo-vit-s 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 212 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 545 s (ONNX + engine).
  • foundationstereo-vit-l load / first call: original 10.86 s / 2.563 s (375x1242), portable 1.98 s / 2.99† s, kernels 1.17† s / 1.517† s
  • foundationstereo-vit-s load / first call: original 1.44 s / 1.058 s (375x1242), portable 1.03 s / 2.514† s, kernels 0.33† s / 1.12† s
  • † measured in the speed sweep after the portable load (or an earlier size) in the same process: file cache and kernels are warm, so the time is lower than a fresh start.
  • Protocol, median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
